description: No public ČNB register of individually approved persons (a searchable 'seznam osob se souhlasem s výkonem funkce' listing approved board members and key function holders) was found in either cs or en searching.

result.result_summary: ČNB publishes entity registers (JERRS) and final enforcement decisions, but approvals of individual statutory-body members appear not to be published as a person-level list; the observable trace is the downstream commercial-register entry.

why_it_matters: The cell's highest-precision hypothesis — a machine-readable feed of approved individuals — does not hold as stated. A5 leadership detection for CZ must be built on ČNB entity registers joined to obchodní rejstřík officer diffs, not on a ČNB person register.

description: The 30-day advance notification duty for changes in the composition of statutory bodies and supervisory boards (reported in secondary legal press, tied to §8ab of the Banking Act) has no located public disclosure channel.

result.result_summary: Notifications are filed to ČNB; no public feed, gazette section or dataset publishing these prior notifications was found.

why_it_matters: The earliest possible leadership signal (~30 days pre-change) exists in law but is not observable, which caps how early A5 can detect CZ bank board moves through official channels.

description: Exact deep-link forms for the JERRS application, the ČNB press-release cs listing, the annual supervision report landing page, and the ARES canonical domain were not confirmed by fetch.

result.result_summary: Search surfaced variant URLs (apl.cnb.cz login/error path, /export/sites PDF paths, ares.cz vs ares.gov.cz, mf.gov.cz vs mfcr.gov.cz); the parent pages that were fetched (seznamy hub, open data) resolved cleanly.

why_it_matters: Downstream verification must resolve these variants before collectors are pinned; a 404 on a guessed deep link should not be read as the source being dead.

description: Access terms, rate limits and any registration requirement for WS JERRS were not established.

result.result_summary: The documentation page describes three XML services and a standardised request/response flow, but the fetch summary did not expose endpoint URLs, WSDL location, or usage conditions.

why_it_matters: WS JERRS is the cell's best automation target; unresolved access terms are the main implementation risk for the whole A5 CZ register pipeline.

description: Air Bank has a 'Pro novináře' page but no year-partitioned press-release archive comparable to KB/ČS/rb.cz was surfaced; the site's contact route for media/marketing is a generic address (marketing@airbank.cz).

result.result_summary: Only /pro-novinare/ and annual-report PDFs confirmed as durable Air Bank primary surfaces.

why_it_matters: Air Bank leadership moves may need to be caught via PPF group communications or secondary media rather than a bank newsroom feed.

description: For UniCredit Bank CZ, Banka CREDITAS and Partners Banka I did not surface the canonical Czech press-centre index URL in search results — only an /en/ subpage (UniCredit), the site root (Creditas), or a single article slug (Partners Banka).

result.result_summary: Newsroom existence is near-certain for all three but the exact listing paths were not observed and are recorded as best-guess entry points with lowered confidence.

why_it_matters: A crawler seeded on a guessed index path would silently collect nothing; these three need a nav-resolution pass before scheduling.

description: Czech-domiciled payment institutions (Global Payments Česko, Worldline CZ) show no dense Czech-language press-release stream on their own domains; searches on 'platební instituce' + 'tisková zpráva' + appointment terms returned company/contact pages rather than appointment announcements.

result.result_summary: No CZ payment-institution appointment press release found in this pass.

why_it_matters: The A5 signal for non-bank PSPs will have to come from wires (Protext), registry filings, or LinkedIn-type surfaces rather than corporate newsrooms — a structural gap in this cell, not a search failure.

description: Raiffeisenbank's 2026 press-release folders surfaced only product news (business services, mobile banking); the only board-change release observed on rb.cz dates to 2018.

result.result_summary: No 2026 Raiffeisenbank leadership announcement located in this pass.

why_it_matters: Absence of a hit in search is not absence of a release; the year/month folder enumeration should be run directly rather than relying on search indexing.

description: No dedicated public page was found linking Poštovní spořitelna / ČSOB's postal-counter banking arrangement to a specific state tender or to named programme owners on the state side.

result.result_summary: Searches combining ČSSZ, Česká pošta and Poštovní spořitelna with 'státní zakázka' returned only generic civil-service vacancy and Czech Post recruitment pages; the ČSOB partnership is described only in marketing terms on ceskaposta.cz.

why_it_matters: The postal-banking interface is a structurally important CZ public-sector payments channel; without a documented source, org changes there will only be visible indirectly via Czech Post vacancies and ČSOB press releases.

description: The Věstník veřejných zakázek appears to have migrated from vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz to vvz.nipez.cz, but this was not confirmed by fetching either host.

result.result_summary: Search results reference both hosts; portal-vz.cz states the new Věstník is at vvz.nipez.cz. Old-domain search-form URLs still appear in results.

why_it_matters: A collector pinned to the legacy domain may silently harvest nothing or break; both endpoints must be tested by the deterministic verification pass before either is retired.

description: No confirmed machine-readable export or API was identified for ISoSS (portal.isoss.cz) civil-service vacancy data.

result.result_summary: Only descriptive references to ISoSS publication duties were found; the portal itself was not fetched and no dataset endpoint surfaced in search.

why_it_matters: ISoSS is the highest-value A5 feed in this cell; if only HTML scraping is possible, collection cost and fragility rise materially.

description: No municipal-level (Praha, Brno, Ostrava, kraje) buyer profile was identified for banking/payment services within this run.

result.result_summary: Queries in this slice were centred on central-government actors; municipal acquiring/banking-services tenders were not searched in Czech.

why_it_matters: Municipalities are a large, distinct segment of public-sector payment buying (fee collection, parking, card acceptance) with their own org units; leaving them out biases the cell toward central government.

description: NKÚ (Nejvyšší kontrolní úřad) audit reports were not searched in this run despite being an obvious 'who audits' category for state payments programmes.

result.result_summary: Not queried; category identified from first principles but not executed within the search budget.

why_it_matters: NKÚ audit conclusions routinely name programme owners, describe unit responsibilities and criticise governance — dense org-change evidence unavailable elsewhere.

description: Accenture does not appear to publish a Czech-language newsroom announcing CZ financial-services practice leadership. Searches in cs returned only generic CZ company profiles and country-lead appointments for other markets (Switzerland, Italy).

result.result_summary: No CZ-specific Accenture FS leadership announcement located in either language; only accenture.com global FS leadership page and third-party company registries (EMIS).

why_it_matters: Accenture is a named actor in this cell and a major CZ bank supplier; absent a CZ newsroom, its FS leadership moves will only be visible via LinkedIn or Czech trade press, which changes the collection method entirely.

description: No evidence found of a Temenos or Finastra implementation at Air Bank or other CZ challenger banks; the only CZ core-banking case study located is Komerční banka on Temenos.

result.result_summary: Searches returned Komerční banka material exclusively; no CZ challenger-bank core-banking vendor disclosure surfaced.

why_it_matters: Suggests either genuine concentration of disclosed core-banking modernisation at KB, or that other CZ banks contractually forbid vendor publicity — a structural limit on this cell's visibility that must not be read as absence of projects.

description: No named CZ bank card-personalisation bureau contract could be attributed to Thales or IDEMIA. Their pages describe global personalisation-centre capability with no Czech customer or site disclosure; no Austria Card CZ presence surfaced.

result.result_summary: Global vendor marketing pages only; no CZ-specific reference, bureau location, or bank customer named.

why_it_matters: Card personalisation is a high-signal spend category; if the international bureaux disclose nothing for CZ, the domestic route (Monet+, BlackCard, Card Centrum) plus equipment distributors becomes the only trace.

description: Software602's site surfaced product and blog content but no bank-named case study ('případová studie') was located in cs search.

result.result_summary: Product pages, ETSI conformance claims and Bank iD blog content found; no bank reference page identified.

why_it_matters: Means Software602 must be tracked via product/press announcements and third-party (Bank iD, agenturacas.gov.cz) documents rather than a reference index.

description: Vendor hiring signal via CZ job boards (jobs.cz, prace.cz, pracezarohem.cz, StartupJobs) could not be sampled through general web search — search engines surface board landing pages rather than live vendor-side listings.

result.result_summary: Query for supplier-side 'core banking' consultant roles in Prague returned bank career portals (kb.jobs.cz, ČNB) rather than vendor postings.

why_it_matters: The A5 jobs/hiring workstream depends on vendor-side listings; these require direct board search endpoints or per-vendor careers-page crawling, not search-engine discovery.

description: No URL in this slice was fetch-verified; all entries derive from search-result metadata and summaries. LinkedIn company pages in particular are expected to be partially gated.

result.result_summary: Liveness and content-shape unverified by design; deferred to the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-trusting URL structure; several deep links (e.g. dated KPMG/EY newsroom paths) are likely to move or be re-slugged.

description: No standalone Czech event branded 'Banking Summit' was found. Searching 'Retail Summit 2026 Praha program řečníci Banking Summit' returned only Blue Events' Retail Summit / New Retail Summit (SK) and unrelated foreign summits.

result.result_summary: The 'Banking Summit' element of the cell definition appears to be either an alias for another event (most plausibly ČBA's Payments Summit or the Banking Innovation Forum) or a non-CZ brand. Treated as unresolved, not as a discovered source.

why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated source entry and flags that the cell brief's event list needs correcting so downstream collection is not scheduled against a non-existent event.

description: No award or conference series branded exactly 'Bankovní inovace' was located in CZ. The cs query surfaced adjacent but differently-named things: VŠE's 'Rozvoj a inovace finančních produktů', 'Banking Innovation Forum & Expo', Economia's 'Inovace v platebních kartách' and Měšec's 'FIN (R)Evoluce'.

result.result_summary: The concept exists in CZ but is distributed across several separately-branded events rather than one 'Bankovní inovace' brand.

why_it_matters: Collection must target the four real event brands rather than a single assumed one, or the innovation/digital-leadership title layer will be missed entirely.

description: The Payments Summit (ČBA) page fetched showed no visible archive of past editions — only the current 2026 speakers/programme. Speakers are also added incrementally ('additional speakers will be announced').

result.result_summary: Historical speaker rosters for this high-value ČBA event may not be retrievable from the live site. Recorded as a hypothesis from a single fetch, not a verdict.

why_it_matters: Title-drift detection needs two editions. If no on-site archive exists, the collector must snapshot every crawl itself and backfill from the Wayback Machine, otherwise the first year yields no signal at all.

description: For Zlatý měšec (Měšec.cz), cs search did not surface a page naming jury members, unlike Zlatá koruna and Banka roku. Only voting and results pages were found.

result.result_summary: Zlatý měšec is retained as a low-priority indirect source; its jury roster is unconfirmed rather than confirmed-absent.

why_it_matters: Avoids over-scoring an award as a personnel census when only its results are public.

description: cashlessfuture.cz surfaced with 2022 as the most recent identifiable edition; no 2023-2026 edition was found in cs or en search.

result.result_summary: Possibly dormant. Not recorded as dead — no fetch failure was observed and absence from search is weak evidence.

why_it_matters: Scheduling recurring collection against a dormant event wastes crawl budget; but its archived roster still has back-dating value.

description: Across all cs and en queries in this cell, no event or award source was found that publishes job vacancies or hiring volume. Speaker/jury rosters reveal incumbency and role changes only.

result.result_summary: The 'jobs'/'hiring' topics of the run scope are structurally under-served by the events-and-awards cell.

why_it_matters: Signals to the run owner that hiring-volume topics must be carried by other cells (job boards, ATS pages, LinkedIn) — this cell should be scored on leadership-move and org-change detection only.

description: Searched in Czech for a public, itemised register of hromadné propouštění notifications naming the employer. Úřad práce ČR publishes counts and sector breakdowns (press releases, regional annual reports, open data), but I found no evidence of a public per-employer notification register.

result.result_summary: Aggregate-only disclosure found; per-employer notifications appear not to be published, only aggregated (e.g. '15 notifications, up to 831 employees' in a month, with sector groupings like energy, clothing, machinery).

why_it_matters: Means firm-level detection of a Czech bank's collective redundancy must come from unions, media or ad-hoc ÚP/regional statements — the statutory notification itself is not a directly harvestable source. Consider an Info Act (zákon č. 106/1999 Sb.) request as a collection method.

description: Searched in Czech for works councils (rada zaměstnanců) and European Works Councils (evropská rada zaměstnanců) specifically in Czech banks. Only generic legal/explanatory material was found (Labour Code Part 12, ČMKOS guide PDF, MPSV handbook, academic theses).

result.result_summary: No public register or directory of which Czech banks have a rada zaměstnanců or which are covered by an EWC of their foreign parent (Erste, KBC, Société Générale, UniCredit, Raiffeisen).

why_it_matters: EWC-level consultation is where group-wide offshoring/restructuring affecting the Czech subsidiary is first disclosed. Absent a register, coverage must be inferred from parent-group union federations (UNI Europa Finance) and from parent annual/sustainability reports.

description: OSPPP publishes the existence of a higher-level collective agreement (Kolektivní smlouva vyššího stupně, KSVS 2022-2025) in its documents section, but firm-level collective agreements at individual banks were not found publicly.

result.result_summary: Only the sector-level KSVS is publicly referenced; per-bank kolektivní smlouvy are not published.

why_it_matters: Firm-level agreements contain redundancy severance multiples and job-security clauses — high-value org-change intelligence that is only obtainable via the union or leaked/reported summaries. Also: the KSVS end-date 2022-2025 suggests a successor agreement should exist and be tracked.

description: Úřad práce ČR moved its web presence to up.gov.cz in February 2026; historical links live under uradprace.cz and mpsv.cz/up-cz.

result.result_summary: Three coexisting host patterns observed in search results for the same statistical pages.

why_it_matters: A collector built on old paths will produce false 'dead source' verdicts. All ÚP URLs in this slice should be treated as unverified until a deterministic liveness pass resolves the current canonical host.

description: Direct cs-language search for Czech discussion-forum threads about bank reorganisations/layoffs returned no forum threads at all — only Wikipedia history pages and statistics.

result.result_summary: Query 'diskuzní fórum zaměstnanci banky reorganizace propouštění Česko Reddit czech' surfaced zero forum URLs; the search engine itself advised checking r/czech directly. No classic Czech forum (e.g. a bank-employee board) was located this run.

why_it_matters: The forum layer of this cell is currently unmapped; if a dedicated CZ finance-employee forum exists it would be the earliest signal source and is being missed.

description: Brno Daily (brnodaily.com), an English-language Brno outlet named in the cell scope, could not be confirmed in search results this run.

result.result_summary: A combined query returned ABSL/expats.cz material but no brnodaily.com hits; the outlet is therefore neither confirmed live nor confirmed dead and is deliberately NOT listed as a candidate.

why_it_matters: English-language Brno coverage aimed at the SSC expat workforce is a distinct sub-layer; leaving it unresolved is a real gap rather than an absence of the source.

description: Ostravan.cz was named in the cell scope/seed but produced no confirmable hits and was not fetched.

result.result_summary: Search for Ostravan.cz returned Patriot, POLAR and regionostrava.cz instead. Ostravan.cz is recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: Do not conclude the outlet is gone on this basis; a targeted fetch should be attempted in the verification pass.

description: No regional editions were confirmed for Plzeň, Liberec, Olomouc, Zlín, České Budějovice or Ústí nad Labem despite the Deník network covering every kraj.

result.result_summary: Only Moravskoslezský, Brněnský (inferred) and Hradecký editions were reached; the remaining kraj editions were not searched this run.

why_it_matters: ABSL names Liberec among business-services cities; a bank back-office there would be invisible to the current source set.

description: Glassdoor CZ was not fetched; its login wall and anti-scraping ToS are asserted from general knowledge, not observed this run.

result.result_summary: Recorded as blocked=true with blocker_type=login_wall_and_tos and an explicit note that this is a hypothesis.

why_it_matters: The English-language employee-voice layer may be less accessible than Atmoskop, changing the collection plan for international SSC staff sentiment.

description: Repeated searches for Finextra and The Paypers articles specifically about Czech Republic bank/payments appointments returned no CZ-specific hits; the outlets' appointment coverage surfaced was for non-CZ companies.

result.result_summary: Finextra/The Paypers confirmed as live appointment-covering outlets, but no evidence of systematic CZ people coverage. They should be treated as thin, opportunistic feeds rather than reliable CZ trackers.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-weighting these two seed outlets in the collection plan; parent-company newsrooms carry the actual CZ signal.

description: SeeNews is scoped to Southeast Europe/Balkans; searches for Czech banking appointments there returned only incidental Czech mentions (e.g. a Slovenian firm's Czech subsidiary).

result.result_summary: SeeNews is live and has a banking vertical, but Czechia is out of its core geography.

why_it_matters: The cell brief lists SeeNews as a seed; downgrading it avoids wasted crawl budget.

description: No dedicated Czech banking section could be located for emerging-europe.com via search; results redirected to CNBC's unrelated 'Emerging Europe' branded page.

result.result_summary: Emerging Europe as a CZ banking-people source is unconfirmed in this pass — recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: A named seed source could not be substantiated; a later pass should fetch emerging-europe.com directly rather than rely on search indexing.

description: The seed query referenced 'PaymentsCVE-type newsletters'; no such outlet or newsletter could be identified in search. It appears to be a placeholder rather than a real publication.

result.result_summary: No source recorded; not fabricated.

why_it_matters: Keeps the source register free of invented entities.

description: No dedicated Reuters or Bloomberg CEE/Prague desk landing page for banking people-moves was confirmed in this pass; their CZ appointment coverage appears distributed across general company news rather than a trackable section.

result.result_summary: Reuters/Bloomberg not recorded as discrete sources; both are also heavily bot-defended and licence-restricted for automated collection.

why_it_matters: Collection design should route wire coverage through licensed feeds or mirrors rather than assuming a scrapable desk page.

description: No Czech-language corporate newsroom or appointment PR was surfaced for Euronet (ATM operator), Diebold Nixdorf s.r.o. or NCR/Atos Czech country teams despite targeted cs queries.

result.result_summary: Searches using 'Euronet ... Česká republika ... jmenování ředitel' returned only company profiles/directories (EMIS) and no CZ press-release channel; ATM-estate and terminal-vendor country leadership appears not to be publicised in CZ media.

why_it_matters: ATM/terminal operators are an explicit part of this cell; without a direct channel their org changes will have to be inferred from the commercial register and LinkedIn rather than announcements.

description: No dedicated acquiring-arm newsroom identified for ČSOB or Komerční banka merchant-acquiring businesses within this pass.

result.result_summary: Bank acquiring arms did not surface as separately branded press channels in the cs/en queries run; individual moves surfaced only indirectly (e.g. a ČSOB card-acceptance product manager moving to Twisto).

why_it_matters: Bank-owned acquiring is a large share of CZ card acceptance; its org signal may sit in bank press rooms (cell #1/#2 territory) rather than payments-specific channels, creating a hand-off risk between cells.

description: LinkedIn company pages are the richest appointment channel for CZ PSPs but are login-walled and ToS-restricted.

result.result_summary: GOPAY s.r.o. and Comgate LinkedIn pages were identified as real, active channels, but automated collection is not permissible.

why_it_matters: The single highest-yield 'newsroom' for this cell cannot be legally automated, forcing manual review or licensed data.

description: No card-scheme (Visa/Mastercard) Czech-office press or careers channel was located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Queries in this slice were spent on acquirers/processors; scheme CZ country offices were not covered by any returned result.

why_it_matters: Scheme country managers are named in the cell brief; leaving them unscouted is a coverage hole.

description: The referenced routine playbook path is a Windows/Dropbox path not present on this macOS machine.

result.result_summary: C:/Users/User/Dropbox/.../routine_prompt.md could not be read from this environment; method was followed from the inline brief instead.

why_it_matters: Any playbook-specific field conventions or scoring rubrics may be missed.

description: The seed premise of a named 'Lidé a kariéra' rubric on E15.cz could not be confirmed. Searching in Czech for the exact phrase returned E15 career-adjacent content (finexpert/prace-a-mzda) and the E15 magazine, but no landing page for a rubric with that name.

result.result_summary: No E15 'Lidé a kariéra' section URL found; E15 people-moves coverage appears distributed across the byznys/finance-a-bankovnictvi desk and topic tag pages instead.

why_it_matters: A collector built around an assumed E15 rubric URL would silently collect nothing; it must instead target the finance desk plus tag indexes.

description: The three highest-credibility outlets in this cell for unannounced departures — Hospodářské noviny, Týdeník Ekonom and Deník N — are subscription products. Anonymous fetches return teasers.

result.result_summary: Headlines, ledes and tag/archive indexes are retrievable; article bodies are not.

why_it_matters: Event detection is still possible from headlines, but the reasons behind a departure — the analytic value of this cell — sit behind the paywall and need a licensing decision.

description: The Bankovnictví online 'Personálie' section, the single most sector-precise personalia column found, showed no RSS/Atom link in the fetched page markup, and item publication dates were not exposed in the listing markup (only in-body phrasing like 'od 1. srpna').

result.result_summary: Collection will require HTML listing diffing and date inference from article bodies.

why_it_matters: Raises collector fragility and makes precise event dating harder for an otherwise ideal source.

description: English-language search for Czech banking executive departures ('Czech business daily banking executive steps down') surfaced almost no Czech-outlet English coverage; the Czech business press does not maintain English personalia desks.

result.result_summary: Czech-language collection is effectively mandatory for this cell; English is only viable via international wires for the largest names.

why_it_matters: Confirms that an English-only pipeline for CZ A5 would miss the overwhelming majority of events.

description: No dedicated banking/finance people-moves column was located at Seznam Zprávy, Euro.cz or Patria.cz; their coverage of moves is incidental within general business/market streams rather than a standing ledger.

result.result_summary: For those three outlets, keyword monitoring is the only viable approach — there is no section to subscribe to.

why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for recall per outlet and pushes the ledger role onto Newstream, Bankovnictví online, Měšec and MediaGuru.

description: Robert Walters was named in the cell brief, but cs and en searches returned only Robert Walters Germany, Switzerland and Africa banking/financial-services pages plus unrelated CZ business-register entries for a person named 'Robert Walter'. No evidence surfaced of a Robert Walters Czech Republic office or CZ salary survey.

result.result_summary: No CZ-specific Robert Walters entity or publication found in this pass; the CZ market appears to be covered by Hays, Grafton, Reed, Randstad, Manpower and the retained-search boutiques instead.

why_it_matters: Prevents allocating collection effort to a source that may not exist for CZ; if Robert Walters covers CZ it is likely served remotely from Germany/Austria, so the DE site would be the place to look.

description: Talentica s.r.o. (talentica.cz), named in the cell brief, self-describes as a specialist agency for technically oriented professionals in automotive, mechanical/electrical engineering, electronics and IT, based in Prague 6 and Brno.

result.result_summary: Talentica is not a financial-services recruiter; no banking/payments salary or hiring publications found.

why_it_matters: Should be dropped from the CZ banking HR watchlist to avoid noise, unless tracked narrowly for bank IT/engineering hiring spillover.

description: Grafton Recruitment's full salary survey is explicitly distributed only to current or prospective client HR departments in electronic form; Hays' full guide and several Randstad/Reed reports appear to sit behind registration forms.

result.result_summary: The richest per-position banking pay data from recruiters is gated; only summary pages and press releases are openly collectable.

why_it_matters: Collection design must rely on PR republication (kurzy.cz, e15.cz, penize.cz, hrnews.cz) as the open proxy layer, or on a legitimate client relationship for the full datasets.

description: No CZ recruiter or headhunter was found publishing a dedicated banking/payments-only hiring or salary report; banking appears as one sector inside general multi-sector guides (Hays 12 specialisations, Grafton 9 sectors, Manpower MEOS 'finance, pojišťovnictví a nemovitosti').

result.result_summary: Sector granularity must be reconstructed from sector chapters and index values rather than from a dedicated banking talent report.

why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for extraction: the unit of collection is a sector chapter or a single index number, not a standalone banking report.

description: Personalista.com resolves over plain HTTP and search snippets showed mangled diacritics, suggesting a legacy/possibly semi-abandoned site. No fetch was performed to confirm.

result.result_summary: Listed as a candidate with low priority and an encoding caveat; liveness and update cadence unverified.

why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should confirm whether the site still publishes before any crawler is pointed at it.

description: Searched in Czech for the exact seed pattern 'vedoucí oddělení platebního styku' on Jobs.cz; no such live listing surfaced in results, only the category page and bank career portals.

result.result_summary: Category and employer portals found; no specific payments-department-head ad observed at search time.

why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell must be worked as a monitored time series (repeated diffs), not as a one-shot search — the signal is the appearance of such a role, which is rare and episodic.

description: Techloop, Cocuma and Jenda.cz — Czech tech-specific boards named in the search — did not surface in results; their current status (live, merged, or defunct) is unconfirmed.

result.result_summary: Search returned only international boards (Glassdoor, Wellfound, EuroTechJobs, WeAreDevelopers) instead.

why_it_matters: One or more CZ-native tech boards may be dead or rebranded; assuming they exist would risk a fabricated source. They need direct verification before being added.

description: No public RSS/API/open-data feed for CZ bank vacancies was identified on Jobs.cz, Prace.cz or StartupJobs.cz during this pass.

result.result_summary: All discovered access is HTML search UI; the ÚP/MPSV register is the only candidate for a structured official feed and its canonical endpoint was not located.

why_it_matters: Collection design must assume HTML snapshotting under ToS constraints, or pursue the MPSV register as the compliant structured alternative.

description: LinkedIn Jobs and Glassdoor — the two richest sources for senior/leadership CZ banking roles — both gate depth behind login and prohibit automated collection.

result.result_summary: Recorded as blocked=true with manual-review-only collection methods.

why_it_matters: The leadership-moves half of this cell cannot be automated; it needs analyst time budgeted, or a licensed data provider.

description: LinkedIn post-level search is not reachable from a logged-out client. Public web search surfaces LinkedIn PROFILE pages (and their headline/summary text) but almost never individual 'nastupuji do' / 'excited to join' POST permalinks for CZ banking.

result.result_summary: Four idiom-based queries in cs and en returned profile URLs and unrelated pages, no retrievable post permalinks.

why_it_matters: The cell's core premise — that individuals announce moves before their employer does — is true, but the announcement text itself is not machine-collectable at scale without LinkedIn credentials or a licensed data provider. Collection design must lean on profile-headline diffing plus press-side mirrors.

description: No Czech banking or payments professional/institutional accounts were identified on Bluesky beyond a generic #Czech hashtag feed.

result.result_summary: Query for CZ banking/fintech on bsky.app returned bank websites and one hashtag page, no sector accounts.

why_it_matters: Bluesky is the only openly crawlable microblog of the three; if the CZ banking community is not there, the open-data path for this cell is effectively closed and budget should go to LinkedIn-mirroring press instead.

description: Official X accounts were confirmed for Air Bank and Raiffeisenbank ČR, but no X account was confirmed for Komerční banka or ČSOB in this pass (Komerční banka appeared only via Facebook, Raiffeisenbank ČR also via Instagram).

result.result_summary: cs-language query for official CZ bank X profiles returned two X handles plus Facebook/Instagram alternates.

why_it_matters: Absence here is unverified, not established — it should be retested before concluding the two largest banks have abandoned X, since X's own search is login-walled and search engines index it poorly.

description: No established Czech-language equivalent was found for 'alumni note' / 'leaver post' as a discrete content genre; Czech leavers write free-form 'po X letech odcházím' style posts with no canonical phrase, and no Czech bank alumni network page was located.

result.result_summary: Searches produced no CZ bank alumni association or leaver-note convention.

why_it_matters: Departures are the higher-signal half of org change (they precede a vacancy and often a strategy shift) and this run currently has no reliable local-language query handle for them.

description: The public part of the Evidence skutečných majitelů (esm.justice.cz) and its open data were made inaccessible by the Ministry of Justice on 17 December 2025.

result.result_summary: MSp announcement and FAU summary confirm public access and open data withdrawal; remaining access is via datová schránka for one's own extract, JIP for public authorities, or formal request.

why_it_matters: Beneficial-ownership tracing of CZ payment institutions and fintech SPVs can no longer be done openly. Any A5 workflow that assumed ESM as a free ownership layer must be redesigned around commercial-register ownership data and pre-2026 archived ESM snapshots.

description: The amended Czech law on přeměny (transformations) removed the requirement to publish merger notices in Obchodní věstník; merger projects and creditor warnings are now deposited into the Sbírka listin at least one month before approval.

result.result_summary: Confirmed across multiple CZ legal commentaries (epravo.cz, matidal.cz) surfaced by the Obchodní věstník query.

why_it_matters: Monitoring Obchodní věstník alone will now MISS bank/fintech restructurings. The Sbírka listin document feed must be the primary M&A/restructuring early-warning channel for CZ.

description: Two register domains appear to be migrating: Obchodní věstník results now resolve under ov.gov.cz (seed assumed ov.justice.cz), and a new public-register portal verejnerejstriky.msp.gov.cz is running alongside or.justice.cz.

result.result_summary: Live search results returned ov.gov.cz record URLs and verejnerejstriky.msp.gov.cz search pages; the legacy ov.ihned.cz mirror also still appears.

why_it_matters: Any hardcoded collector URLs against ov.justice.cz or or.justice.cz carry migration risk; a URL-stability check should be part of the recurring pipeline rather than a one-off.

description: No statutory register source was found that records non-statutory HIRING — i.e. ordinary staff appointments, headcount, or department reorganisations below the statutory-body/prokura level.

result.result_summary: CZ registers cover only legally registered particulars: statutory body members, prokuristé, branch heads, ownership, registered office. Rank-and-file hiring simply is not a registrable fact.

why_it_matters: The 'jobs' and 'hiring' topics of this run cannot be served from this cell. They must come from job boards, LinkedIn, and press cells; this cell should be scoped to leadership moves and organisation/legal-entity changes only.

description: Merk.cz was named in the cell scope but was not independently confirmed by fetch in this pass; its access model, API availability and pricing are assumed, not observed.

result.result_summary: Aggregator search surfaced Kurzy.cz, Peníze.cz, Finmag.cz and sledovani-insolvence.cz but did not return a Merk.cz result page.

why_it_matters: Its candidate record carries a deliberately reduced confidence_score; the verification pass should treat it as a priority liveness/capability check before any procurement decision.

description: The cell scope names 'ÚVIS' as a register source; no CZ register of that name relevant to corporate filings was found. ÚVIS (Úřad pro veřejné informační systémy) was abolished in the 2000s and its functions absorbed into the Ministry of Informatics/Interior.

result.result_summary: Searches within this cell surfaced ISIR (insolvency) but nothing matching an active 'ÚVIS' filing register.

why_it_matters: The scope term is likely a stale artefact or a conflation with ISIR; the run definition should be corrected so a downstream collector does not chase a non-existent portal.

description: Searches in Czech and English did not surface a dedicated, separately addressable 'issuer announcements / oznámení emitentů' index page on pse.cz distinct from the general /zpravy (/en/news) feed. Fetching the MONETA ISIN detail page showed Overview, Tick Data, Historical Data, Company Profile, News and a corporate-calendar reference, but no announcements sub-page.

result.result_summary: PSE appears to route issuer regulated disclosures to the general news feed and out to issuer IR sites / ČNB CUri rather than hosting a MAR filing archive of its own. Unverified — the site is JS-heavy and a deeper crawl may reveal one.

why_it_matters: A collector should treat ČNB CUri as the authoritative filing archive and pse.cz only as a timing tripwire; assuming PSE holds the filings would create silent gaps.

description: The ČNB CUri/OAM search application URL (oam.cnb.cz SIPRESWEB entry point) was obtained from search-result text and the ČNB landing page rather than by a direct successful fetch of the application itself.

result.result_summary: Recorded as a candidate with confidence 0.8; liveness and the exact query-parameter contract must be established by the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: This is the single most important source in the cell; if its endpoint has moved, the whole primary-filing channel silently fails.

description: No RSS/Atom or public API was identified for any of the Czech-side sources in this cell (pse.cz, investors.moneta.cz, kb.cz, csob.cz, ČNB CUri) during this pass.

result.result_summary: All Czech-side collection is likely to require HTML scraping plus PDF text extraction.

why_it_matters: Drives collector design and cost; also raises brittleness risk versus the Austrian/Belgian parents where EQS and Euronext offer stable permalinks.

description: Česká spořitelna, ČSOB and Raiffeisenbank a.s. have no Czech equity listing, so no CZ-level MAR management-change disclosure exists for them; only bond-issuer disclosures and parent-level (Erste/KBC/RBI) ad-hoc releases cover their leadership.

result.result_summary: For three of the four largest CZ banks, this cell can only deliver A5 signal via foreign-parent disclosure plus annual-report governance chapters.

why_it_matters: Sets a structural ceiling on this cell's coverage; CZ-entity board changes for these banks must be picked up by other cells (commercial register, ČNB licensing lists, press).

description: No standalone Czech 'payments association' equivalent to a national payments council was found. The functional equivalent is Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) plus ČBA's internal payments committees; SBK's web presence appears split across two domains and possibly stale.

result.result_summary: Searched cs terms for a Czech payments association; only SBK and ČBA committee structures surfaced.

why_it_matters: A scout expecting a single payments-association member directory will not find one; payments actor coverage must be assembled from SBK + ČBA committees + Czech Fintech Association.

description: Fetch of https://www.cbaonline.cz/o-nas/komise-pracovni-skupiny returned only navigation chrome with no committee or chair content.

result.result_summary: Page reachable but substantive content not extracted — likely client-side rendered or behind a content loader.

why_it_matters: The single richest people-source in this cell could not be read by a plain fetch; the collector will need a headless browser rather than static HTTP.

description: No German- or Czech-language finance/banking working group ('Arbeitskreis Finanzen', 'pracovní skupina finance') could be confirmed for ČNOPK (Deutsch-Tschechische Industrie- und Handelskammer), and no financial-services committee page was confirmed for the British Chamber of Commerce CZ.

result.result_summary: Searches in de/en returned only general chamber descriptions; no committee rosters located.

why_it_matters: Two named chambers in the cell brief remain uncovered, so bilateral-chamber people-intelligence is incomplete.

description: AKAT's executive-director name appears inconsistently across sources (Jana Michalíková vs. Jana Brodani), and ČBA membership counts range 34-37 depending on source date.

result.result_summary: Secondary sources disagree; primary association pages were not fetched to resolve.

why_it_matters: Person-level facts from aggregators must be re-anchored to the association's own site or the spolkový rejstřík before entering an intelligence record.

description: LinkedIn association pages are the richest people-graph layer but are login-walled and their ToS prohibit scraping.

result.result_summary: Identified but marked collection_allowed=false.
